prs.location: Located beside the Grand Canal and only a 20-minute walk from the city centre, Harold’s Cross is a lively and bustling suburb with an excellent public transport service.  The local neighbourhoods of Harolds Cross and Rathmines are modern, diverse and steeped in history, and home to an exciting mix of restaurants, pubs and things-to-do.  There is a particularly strong sense of community in the area, Harold’s Cross is well known and well loved, with an exciting entertainment scene and a wide range of local amenities - including a handful of spots serving up delicious coffee and fresh pastries every day.  An excellent choice of sports & leisure facilities nearby. Branching out a little further, locals can avail of the delights on offer in neighbouring Rathgar and Ranelagh, both within short walking distance.

description:
Mill Pond is a stunning new apartment development beside Harold's Cross, a much sought-after address on Dublin's south side, bordering the districts of Dublin 6, 6W and Dublin 12.  Mill Pond is located off Parnell Avenue, adjacent to the Grand Canal and nestled in its own quiet enclave.  Its proximity to local amenities, the city centre and the greater South Dublin area will put residents at the centre of a modern and exciting urban living experience.  The development features a landscaped garden on the grounds with mature planting and seating area for residents' recreation.  

Each apartment at Mill Pond has been treated with its own unique interior design solution - tones and furnishings, carefully selected to create a more central, homely flow.
The fully-equipped kitchens are ultra modern and expertly designed to maximise work and storage space.  The living areas are expertly furnished with low-set couches while a lamp and sideboard complete the look.  Natural lights floods in through floor-to-ceiling sliding doors, which lead out on to a generously-sized balcony. The bedrooms feature calming tones in the interior design - a sanctuary of comfort and rest.   

*Photos and VR Tours represent a mixture of the standard of finishes available throughout the development. 

**Please note: 
1) There are multiple property types available in this development. The photos shown here may not be of the actual unit available but represent the standard of finish. 

2) The rent advertised on the individual property ads represent the starting rent for these property types. Rents will vary throughout the development depending on the specific property type. Not all the available properties and rents are listed here; please use those available at viewings. 

3) The overall BER Rating on this development is A Rated, an individual BER cert for your specific apartment is available on move in, upon request.
